description: The company's monthly recurring revenue (MRR) from its connected Stripe accounts, per currency, with the number of active subscriptions: each subscription item's price times its quantity brought to a month by its billing interval, after the subscription's coupon; trials are left out. connected is false when no Stripe account is connected. Quote the figure as returned. Read-only.
name: stripe_get_recurring_revenue
title: Get Recurring Revenue
